settings.title: System Settings & Categories
settings.subtitle: View system-wide ticket categories, database constraints, and service configurations.
settings.constraintDesc: Ticket categories are governed by the database schema enum (billing, account, technical, orders, general). Dynamic runtime category mutation is not currently supported by the backend API.
settings.notSupportedDesc1: The backend API does not currently expose a persistent endpoint to register new ticket categories. Ticket categories are constrained by the Prisma schema enum and MySQL database definition.
settings.notSupportedDesc2: To add new categories, contact the engineering team to coordinate a Prisma schema migration.
